help: Bank of Starsector: prints your credit score, PBC relation, loans, investments, fleet insurance (including ships insured elsewhere and payouts billed back) and the Sovereign Desk.

Bank of Starsector: lists every faction holding markets and whether the Sovereign Desk treats it as a state (bonds, treasury, war surcharge, foreclosure bids) or leaves it out, and why. Override with politicalFactions / nonPoliticalFactions in data/config/bos_settings.json.
